description: This PHP source file defines the Currency controller class within the Opencart admin module. It manages currency-related tasks such as listing currencies, refreshing data, clearing cached JSON files, and scheduling currency tasks.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class handling currency-related administrative tasks such as listing, refreshing, and clearing currency data for the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up currency tasks by clearing old data and scheduling new currency tasks, returning a success message.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing currency data and stores it in the localisation data directory, returning success or error message.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates currency values by invoking the appropriate extension handler and schedules a task to regenerate currency info, returning a success message.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing cached currency JSON files for each language, returning a confirmation message.
